caption: The drawing depicts two main objects against a plain, off-white background. The larger object, positioned diagonally from the lower left to the right side, appears to be a pair of metal tongs or forceps with two elongated, straight handles ending in circular loops. The ends of the handles join at a pivot, leading to a set of flat, circular plates at the other end, which align when the handles are closed. The object is rendered in dark gray tones, suggesting a metallic material. Above this, in the upper right portion of the drawing, is a circular, medallion-like object drawn in grayscale. The medallion features a symmetrical, ornamental design composed of leaves and small floral shapes filling much of its surface. The illustration style is precise, with detailed line work and shading that highlights the textures and three-dimensional form of both objects. At the bottom right, there is a handwritten note indicating the scale of the drawing ("1/3 SIZE"), along with a signature ("P. Ward").
title: Wafer Iron
